_about: Well-known AWS IAM privilege-escalation primitives. The analyzer SIMULATES whether the discovered identity is *allowed* the listed actions (iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy — policy evaluation only, NO action is performed). A rule fires only if EVERY action in `actions` simulates as allowed. Derived from public IAM-privesc research (Rhino Security Labs). AUTHORIZED-ASSESSMENT data — safe to delete/extend.

_schema.id: stable identifier (also used as a finding tag)
_schema.name: human-readable escalation technique
_schema.actions: ALL IAM actions that must simulate as allowed for the technique to work

rules.name: Create access key for another IAM user
rules.detail: Mint long-lived credentials for any user (e.g. an admin) and assume their identity.

rules.name: Set a console password for another IAM user
rules.detail: Create a console login profile for a privileged user and sign in as them.

rules.name: Reset another IAM user's console password
rules.detail: Overwrite a privileged user's console password and take over the account.

rules.name: Attach a managed policy to self/user
rules.detail: Attach AdministratorAccess to the current user, granting full account control.

rules.name: Inline-policy self/user
rules.detail: Add an inline allow-* policy to the current user for full control.

rules.name: Attach a managed policy to a role
rules.detail: Attach AdministratorAccess to an assumable role, then assume it.

rules.name: Inline-policy a role
rules.detail: Add an inline allow-* policy to an assumable role, then assume it.

rules.name: Create a new default policy version
rules.detail: Publish a new default version of a managed policy with elevated permissions.

rules.name: Roll back to a permissive policy version
rules.detail: Set the default version of a managed policy to an older, more permissive one.

rules.name: Rewrite a role trust policy + assume it
rules.detail: Edit a role's trust policy to trust yourself, then assume the (privileged) role.

rules.name: PassRole to a new Lambda function
rules.detail: Create a Lambda running as a privileged role and invoke it to act with its perms.

rules.name: PassRole to a new EC2 instance
rules.detail: Launch an EC2 instance with a privileged instance profile and read its credentials.

rules.name: Create a role and pass it
rules.detail: Create a new role with elevated permissions and pass it to a compute service.
